title: Each mizaj at a dinner party (dawat)
caption:
There's a Damvi, a Safravi, a Balghami and a Saudavi at every dawat.

One hugs everyone and is still chatting at the gate an hour later. One gets a little irritable by 9:30 and turns delightful the moment the biryani arrives. One has found the comfiest sofa. One is having a deep conversation with exactly one person.

Hosting this weekend? Use the seating tips on the last slide.

Which guest are you?
